messages:
Maya: Heads-up: noticed failures in canary image verification after KMS key rotation in staging. cosign verify errors around envelope signature not found. Anyone else seeing audit gaps in cloud logging for the signing service?
Alex: yep saw alerts. Splunk shows no 'sign' events between 03:12-03:24 UTC. suspect signing service lost KMS grant perms during rotation.
TJ: @Maya can you paste the exact cosign error? also which KMS: gcp-kms or aws-kms?
Maya: Error: `error verifying signature: could not verify attestation: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = key version not found` — using gcp-kms/cosign sigstore integration.
Samir: Oncall saw same. We had a KMS key alias swap (rotation) and IAM binding was briefly removed for `serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-prod`. RBAC for signer SA in staging was overly tight.
security-bot: Alert: audit_sink missing 12 events for project redwood-staging.gcp. Investigating.
Alex: Quick mitigation: rollback to previous key version (if available) or re-grant `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign` to signer SA. Also need to re-run `cosign verify-blob` after grant.
Maya: Can someone run this Splunk query? `index=cloud-audit resource.type=kms | where protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" | stats count by protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp`
TJ: I'll run and paste results. Also, we should add a temporary fallback in runtime to accept attestations signed with prev key version for 15 mins to allow catch-up.
Samir: Note: we don't currently log key version in image-sign metadata. We should start emitting `x-sign-key-version` header in signer logs and cosign annotations.
Maya: :thumbsup: Good call. I'll open a quick PR to add header and update the canary verifier to accept an env var `ALLOW_OLD_KEY_VER`.
Alex: For RBAC: propose a new role `roles/kms.signerTemp` that includes only useToSign for specific keyName and limited TTL. Add to runbook.
TJ: Also add a logging check in rollout: ensure at least 1 AsymmetricSign per minute from signer SA during rotation window; fail rotation if drops below threshold.
oncall: I've re-granted `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign` to signer SA for the old key while key admin fixes alias. Canaries green now.
Maya: Thanks. Action items: 1) Samir - add x-sign-key-version header (PR). 2) Alex - draft ephemeral role and runbook snippet. 3) TJ - add rotation health check query. 4) Maya - PR for verifier env var.
Samir: Will do, ETA 2h for PR to staging.
Alex: I'll draft role + runbook and ping legal for audit retention note. ETA EOD.
TJ: I'll add the Splunk alert + test it in sandbox.
Maya: Leaving notes here for postmortem, moving to #incidents if we need full triage.
security-bot: Closed alert: events reappeared at 03:51 UTC. Incident not escalated.
